title: shabbat_controller
description: Shabbat clock: switches the relay (switch:0) on during your timers inside Shabbat & Yom Tov windows (Israel, 2025-2030, no internet needed). Install, enable Run on startup and Start. Also install shabbat_ui (settings page), then open http://<shelly-ip>/script/<id>/ui.

title: shabbat_ui
description: Settings page for shabbat_controller (Hebrew / English). Keep the name shabbat_ui. Do NOT start it and do not enable Run on startup: it only stores the page code that the controller serves.

title: shabbat_controller (diagnostic)
description: The controller with debug logging and boot memory logs, for troubleshooting. Install instead of shabbat_controller, not alongside it.
